name: First Order landing platform
description: During the Mission to Ovanis, the First Order used a model of landing platform as a staging area to launch both TIE/fo space superiority fighters and TIE/sf space superiority fighters as well as atmospheric assault landers.

data.name: First Order landing platform
complement: At least 2 TIE/fo space superiority fighters
At least 6 TIE/sf space superiority fighters
At least 1 First Order speeder bike
